analytics.title: Anonymous usage data
analytics.description: Help improve SnippetVault by sharing how often its two search entry points are opened. This is off by default.
analytics.details: When enabled, SnippetVault reports only when you open the side panel or open in-page search with double Shift. Searches and all other product actions are never reported.
analytics.permissionDenied: Google Analytics access was not granted. Anonymous usage data remains off.
analytics.saveFailed: Could not update the anonymous usage data setting.

workspace.defaultDescription: Choose how many days a new temporary item remains available.
workspace.newItemsOnly: The default days apply to new temporary items and quick extend. Existing items are not updated in bulk.
workspace.invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1 day.
workspace.saveFailed: Could not save the default expiry.

taxonomy.archiveNotice: Hiding a label only removes it from future choices. Existing snippets keep their saved label.

storage.localDescription: Snippet content and metadata stay in this extension's local IndexedDB.
storage.backupDescription: Export or import a YAML backup. Encrypt it with a passphrase, or export readable plaintext that contains snippet contents, secrets, full URLs, and source metadata.
storage.importReplaceWarning: Importing this backup fully replaces saved labels, vault items, and temporary workspace items.
storage.importPreferencesUnaffected: Your SnippetVault UI preferences are not changed.
storage.backupImportedIndexPending: The data was replaced successfully. Search will rebuild from the imported data.
storage.backupConflict: Local data changed after the preview. Preview the backup again before replacing it.
storage.backupTooLarge: That backup file is too large.
storage.backupFailed: Could not complete the backup action.
storage.noticeTitle: Local data is readable; encrypt your backups
storage.noticeDescription: Anyone with access to this browser profile can read snippet content, secrets, URLs, and source metadata. Unencrypted .sv files are equally readable, so prefer encrypted backups and keep them private.
storage.exportDialogDescription: Choose whether to protect the backup file with a passphrase.
storage.encryptDescription: Uses AES-256-GCM. If you forget the passphrase, the backup cannot be recovered.
storage.plaintextWarning: An unencrypted backup stores every snippet, secret, and source URL as readable YAML. Keep the file private.
storage.decryptDialogDescription: This backup is encrypted. Enter the passphrase used when it was exported.
storage.invalidEncryptedBackup: This is not a valid encrypted backup.
